proposal.reason: Episode evidence: per-step completions tracked the greedy disjoint-triple count almost exactly (pair 8->8 done, 7->7, 4->4, 3->3, 1->1) while 22 tasks remained uncompletable at time_left 10; throughput, not task coverage, was the binding limit. Hypothesis: strengthen the pair term around the true binding constraint min(workers,uavs) (a WUT triple needs one of each) instead of total agents, soften the mean_energy divisor, and shift weight from task/imbalance to pair. Unverified until replay on identical episodes.
